ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 15% high-intensity (white/grey) to 85% low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black background; high-intensity mottled cluster localized on the left lobe proximal to the leading edge; smaller high-intensity cluster on the distal tip of the right lobe; scattered high-intensity circular spots (points) on the lower central regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a sharply defined apex; approximate pixel-calculated angle of 50-60 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile; multiple primary peaks and secondary valleys along the entire continuous trailing edge; highest amplitude serrations located on the outer third of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning into a linear-convex sweep towards the distal tips; symmetrical upward orientation of the outer lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast circular rings (barnacle attachment sites) concentrated on the far-left tip and scattered across the lower-center of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of 3-4 near-parallel, horizontal-oblique linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the lower-right quadrant of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense barnacle colonization and resulting high-intensity scarring on the outer margins and tips of both lobes; irregular jaggedness in the notch-inner-edge interface.
other_distinctive_markers: Fine-scale stippled transition zone on the left lobe where solid high-intensity pigmentation breaks into discrete low-intensity pixel clusters.
